question: How many paid time off days do full-time employees get per year at Nimbus Robotics?
ground_truth_answer: Full-time employees at Nimbus Robotics receive 20 paid time off days per year, accrued monthly.
expected_context: Full-time employees accrue 20 PTO days per year, credited at a rate of 1.67 days per month of employment.

question: What is the maximum amount an employee can be reimbursed for home office equipment?
ground_truth_answer: Employees can be reimbursed up to $500 per calendar year for home office equipment.
expected_context: Nimbus Robotics reimburses up to $500 per calendar year for home office equipment purchases, including monitors, chairs, and desks.

question: How often are company laptops refreshed?
ground_truth_answer: Company laptops are refreshed every 3 years under the standard hardware refresh cycle.
expected_context: Standard-issue laptops follow a 3-year refresh cycle. Employees may request an early refresh if their device fails a hardware diagnostic.

question: Can employees work remotely full-time, or is there a minimum in-office requirement?
ground_truth_answer: Employees must work from the office at least 2 days per week; the remaining days can be remote.
expected_context: Nimbus Robotics operates a hybrid work policy requiring a minimum of 2 in-office days per week, with the remaining days available for remote work.

question: How long does Nimbus Robotics retain employee records after termination?
ground_truth_answer: Nimbus Robotics retains employee records for 7 years after termination of employment.
expected_context: Per the data retention policy, employee records are retained for a period of 7 years following termination, after which they are securely destroyed.
